newsitem.title: MEXICO: Train collides with tanker truck in Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Train collides with tanker truck in Mexico.

text.p: A train collided with a tanker truck carrying gasoline on Monday in a Mexico City suburb, causing the truck to explode in a giant fireball, media reports said. It was unclear if there were any dead.
Television images on Mexico's Televisa network showed the burning remains of the tanker erupt in a huge ball of flame in a main avenue of Ecatepec, in the eastern part of Mexico City.
Radio Red said several people suffered burns in the explosion and that the street next to the railway track was smouldering with spilt gasoline.
Televisa said a nearby hotel and primary school appeared undamaged by the blast.
The train consisted solely of the locomotive and one car.
